misconfigurations.scenario: Kubernetes workload containers do not define both CPU and memory requests
misconfigurations.alert_criteria: A Deployment, StatefulSet, or DaemonSet application container omits a CPU or memory request
misconfigurations.recommendation_action: Measure representative usage and add reviewed requests without changing the live cluster automatically.
misconfigurations.recommendation_description_detailed: Missing requests weaken scheduling, autoscaling, and capacity planning.

misconfigurations.scenario: Kubernetes workload containers do not define memory limits
misconfigurations.alert_criteria: A Deployment, StatefulSet, or DaemonSet application container omits a memory limit
misconfigurations.recommendation_action: Measure peak memory, account for runtime behavior, and add a reviewed limit.
misconfigurations.recommendation_description_detailed: Missing memory limits allow a container to consume memory until node pressure or eviction occurs.

misconfigurations.scenario: Kubernetes workload containers do not define readiness and liveness probes
misconfigurations.alert_criteria: An application container in a Deployment, StatefulSet, or DaemonSet omits readiness or liveness probes
misconfigurations.recommendation_action: Define application-specific probes and validate thresholds in a staged rollout.
misconfigurations.recommendation_description_detailed: Missing probes prevent Kubernetes from reliably routing around or restarting unhealthy containers.

misconfigurations.scenario: Replicated and service-exposed Kubernetes workload has no PodDisruptionBudget
misconfigurations.alert_criteria: A workload has at least two replicas and an associated Service but no selecting PodDisruptionBudget
misconfigurations.recommendation_action: Add a reviewed PodDisruptionBudget that preserves availability without blocking maintenance.
misconfigurations.recommendation_description_detailed: Without a PDB, voluntary disruptions can remove too many replicas at once.

misconfigurations.scenario: Kubernetes workload requests dangerous host or container privileges
misconfigurations.alert_criteria: A workload explicitly enables privileged mode, privilege escalation, host namespaces, hostPath, or dangerous Linux capabilities
misconfigurations.recommendation_action: Remove unnecessary privileges in source manifests and validate the workload in a staged environment.
misconfigurations.recommendation_description_detailed: Dangerous privileges can expand a container compromise to the node or cluster.

misconfigurations.scenario: Kubernetes pod is repeatedly restarting or waiting in CrashLoopBackOff
misconfigurations.alert_criteria: A container is waiting with CrashLoopBackOff or has at least five recent restarts
misconfigurations.recommendation_action: Correlate status, last termination, probes, resource pressure, rollout state, and events before changing the workload.
misconfigurations.recommendation_description_detailed: Restart loops are a symptom; the investigator must distinguish application exit, probe failure, configuration, and resource pressure.

misconfigurations.alert_criteria: PodScheduled is false with an Unschedulable reason for at least five minutes
misconfigurations.recommendation_action: Explain the exact scheduler constraint and compare requests, selectors, taints, affinity, storage, and node capacity.
misconfigurations.recommendation_description_detailed: Pending pods can block availability and deployments, but the scheduler message must support the claimed cause.

misconfigurations.scenario: Kubernetes pod CPU use remains close to its configured limit
misconfigurations.alert_criteria: P95 CPU usage is at least 80 percent of the limit for five of six periods with sufficient datapoints
misconfigurations.recommendation_action: Review HPA state, application behavior, requests, limits, and throttling-specific evidence before changing CPU.
misconfigurations.recommendation_description_detailed: High utilization against a limit is pressure evidence but does not by itself prove CPU throttling.

misconfigurations.scenario: Kubernetes pod has OOM termination or sustained memory pressure near its limit
misconfigurations.alert_criteria: A container was OOMKilled or P95 working set is at least 90 percent of its limit for five of six periods
misconfigurations.recommendation_action: Correlate OOM termination, working set, limits, restarts, node pressure, and application behavior before changing memory.
misconfigurations.recommendation_description_detailed: Memory pressure can cause restarts, eviction, and degraded availability; missing metrics are not interpreted as zero.
